summary: VSE Corp filed an 8-K on May 7, 2026, reporting the May 5, 2026 closing of its acquisition of Precision Aviation Group (PAG) from GenNx360 Capital Partners. The deal was structured via a stock purchase agreement with rollover and cash purchasing subsidiaries. Terms such as price per share and premium were not disclosed in the filing; consideration appears to be cash and stock. Board recommendation is implicit as the company executed the acquisition. The closing triggers entry into exchange/redemption and registration rights agreements. Watch for integration execution and any post-closing adjustments.
